text:
alex_k: heads up — seeing p95/p99 jump in eu-west dedicated slice (slice-42) starting ~10:02 UTC. p95 ~3x, p99 ~5x. Some requests routed to quantized-v2 fallback automatically.
infra-bot: Alert: gpu-node-42 thermal mitigation engaged, clock_slowdown=1, affected_slices=[slice-42], anomaly_id=an-20260320-01 :red_circle:
maria_ops: think this is the same cluster that had sporadic fan errors last month? can you paste node telemetry?
chen_ml: KV cache hit rate for the affected tenants dropped from ~72% -> ~12% around the same time. That explains extra compute per request and increased scheduling pressure.
alex_k: log snippet from proxy (trimmed):
```
[10:01:48] route slice-42 req_id=... model=redwood-ggml-v1 batch=1 kv_hit=false
[10:02:03] node gpu-node-42 thermal_tripped=1 fan_pwm=45 clock_mhz=8500 -> 6000
[10:02:05] scheduler fallback route -> quantized-v2 for tenant=acme-inc (latency spike)
```
sam_hw: if fan_pwm dropped the cards will throttle quickly. hardware reported RPM drop on fan2 and fan4, maybe stuck controller.
nia_prod: which tenants hit? we need to see if any SLOs were breached — customers listed as critical: acme-inc, macrolytics.
maria_ops: can we cordon node and move warm KV state off it? Moving warm prefixes will help KV hit rate elsewhere.
alex_k: plan: 1) cordon gpu-node-42 2) trigger graceful drain for slice-42 3) re-route new allocs to warm-pool-eu2 4) spin up replacement node and force KV prewarm for affected prefixes
chen_ml: short-term mitigation: increase kv-prefetch window on proxy for slice-42 to reduce misses while we rebalance.
sam_hw: I'll escalate ops ticket to HW team for fan controller replacement. preliminary root cause hypothesis: fan controller firmware mis-reporting leading to OS throttle.
nia_prod: can we temporarily pin acme-inc to dedicated low-latency pool (pool-id dl-eu-west) until migration done? they'll pay for burst.
alex_k: yes will open rollout for pinning now, @maria_ops can you approve?
maria_ops: approved. doing patch to routing policy: add override for tenant acme-inc -> dl-eu-west, ttl=2h.
infra-bot: Action log: cordon initiated on gpu-node-42 by alex_k at 10:15 UTC. drain started.
chen_ml: after drain started kv hit bounced to ~45% on remaining nodes (prewarm working). p95 trending down.
alex_k: monitoring — will keep pinned routing and follow up after hw replacement. reopening postmortem channel after stabilization. :white_check_mark:
